summary: 'Where is the bathroom' is BATHROOM (a shaken T handshape) followed by WHERE, with lowered eyebrows. The single most useful question in any building.
steps: Sign BATHROOM: make a T handshape (thumb between the index and middle fingers) and shake it side to side.
Sign WHERE: index finger wagging side to side.
Eyebrows down on WHERE and hold the face.
mistakes: Putting WHERE first. BATHROOM WHERE is the ASL order.
